message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: pull_request

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  test:
    if: github.ref != 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
      - name: Setup PNPM
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          version: latest
      - name: Cache pnpm dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.local/share/pnpm/store
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-${{ hashFiles('pnpm-lock.yaml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pnpm-
      - name: Install
        run: pnpm install --dangerously-allow-all-builds
      - name: Test
        run: pnpm test
        env:
          TEST_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID: ${{ secrets.TEST_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID }}
          TEST_SLACK_WEBHOOK: ${{ secrets.TEST_SLACK_WEBHOOK }}
          TOM_STRIPE_KEY: ${{ secrets.TOM_STRIPE_KEY }}
          TOM_TELEGRAM_KEY: ${{ secrets.TOM_TELEGRAM_KEY }}
      - name: Report
        run: npx c8 report --reporter=text-lcov > coverage/lcov.info
      - name: Coverage
        uses: coverallsapp/github-action@main
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Node.js/pnpm CI that runs `pnpm install` on every run with no dependency cache. The P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (dependency_cache) supports caching dependency downloads while keeping installation and all required tests, and the measured experiment example shows adding actions/cache@v4 before the install step. Adding a pnpm store cache keyed on pnpm-lock.yaml reuses downloaded packages across runs, reducing install time without changing coverage, adding privileges, secrets, or new network access.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
